flags.message: gemini-baseline's reasoning.md and predicted_reasoning.md recite docket facts the staged record contradicts (brief in opposition Sep 2 and reply Sep 16; distribution Sep 29 for an Oct 16 conference, an Oct 15 reschedule, redistribution for Oct 30; a 5-4 Georgia Supreme Court denial on Mar 3, 2026). The docket shows distributions Jul 22 for 9/28 and Oct 28 for 11/13, the opposition Oct 14, the reply Oct 28, and a Mar 31, 2026 state order with all participating Justices concurring. The other two candidates, reading the same-named snapshot, report the docket correctly, so this looks like the candidate's error and not a provisioning fault; it is reflected in reasoning_quality and the forecast grade. Scores are unaffected.
